questions.q: Who usually acts as the gimbal manager in Gimbal Protocol v2?
options: The autopilot, which knows the attitude
The gimbal itself, with its own IMU
The operator's ground station over MAVLink
The camera attached to the gimbal
questions.explain: The manager is the autopilot: it turns client commands into angles and decides who is in control; the device is the gimbal.

questions.q: Why is the gimbal yaw kept in lock mode when orbiting a tower?
options: To reduce the load on the gimbal motors
So the camera does not turn with the vehicle
So the gimbal does not overheat in the sun
To get a faster COMMAND_ACK reply
questions.explain: In follow the yaw is measured from the vehicle, in lock from north: a vehicle turn does not swing the camera away.

questions.q: What does MNT1_RC_RATE = 0 mean in ArduPilot?
options: The transmitter does not control the gimbal
The stick sets the rate in °/s
The stick sets the gimbal angle
The gimbal goes to the retracted position
questions.explain: 0 means angle control; a non-zero value is the rotation rate in °/s.

questions.q: What is the MAVLink component ID of a gimbal?
options: 1, the autopilot
100, the camera
191, the onboard computer
154, the gimbal
questions.explain: MAV_COMP_ID_GIMBAL = 154; no component in the inspector, no MAVLink control.

questions.q: How do you set up a shot every 5 m on a mission leg?
options: DO_SET_ROI_LOCATION with a 5 m radius
DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_PITCHYAW with a step of 5
DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST = 5
MNT1_RC_RATE = 5 in the parameters
questions.explain: DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST (or CAM1_TRIGG_DIST) takes a shot per distance traveled, and each one is logged as CAM.

questions.q: Why can the transmitter and companion commands "fight" over the gimbal?
options: No explicit takeover of control at the manager
The transmitter runs on a different frequency
The companion sends its commands in MAVLink 1
The gimbal accepts only one command per second
questions.explain: Without MAV_CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_CONFIGURE the manager does not know which client is primary.

questions.q: What happens to the vehicle right after a payload drop?
options: It loses altitude sharply
It switches to RTL automatically
The gimbal goes to the retracted position
The mass drops in a step and it jumps up
questions.explain: The throttle was set for the larger mass: after the drop the vehicle goes up; drop in a hover with altitude hold.

questions.q: How do you check the center of gravity after installing a payload?
options: By the sound of the motors on the ground
By the motor outputs in a hover in the log
By the gimbal angle while stationary
By the battery voltage after landing
questions.explain: The spread of the average outputs of the front and rear motors shows the CG shift.
